Witch Dev leads with a bold personal introduction, positioning the developer's identity as the most important element on the page before anything else. Circular spellwork geometry radiates outward from the center, and vivid neon accents cut through the dark background with enough energy to feel genuinely electric. The result is a portfolio that is confident, bright, and unmistakably itself.

## Theme Overview

The visual language of Witch Dev draws on circular spellwork diagrams — concentric rings, radiating lines, and geometric inset patterns — to create a sense of magical energy contained and directed outward. Neon accent colors, brighter than the muted palettes of other themes in this category, give the interface a charged, high-contrast quality. The layout prioritizes the personal introduction: name, title, and voice come first, with projects, skills, and links arranged around that foundation.

## Design Highlights

- Circular spellwork geometry — concentric rings and radiating patterns — as the primary visual motif
- Vivid neon accent palette with higher saturation than most dark magical themes
- Strong personal introduction section that centers the developer's identity and voice
- High-contrast dark background that makes neon accents glow with full intensity
- Clear content hierarchy that moves from personal introduction to skills and project showcase

## Who This Theme Suits

Witch Dev is best for developers who lead with personality — those whose name, voice, and identity are as much a part of their brand as their technical skills. The bold neon accents and strong introduction section make it especially effective for developers with an established online presence or a strong personal aesthetic who want their portfolio to reflect that energy directly.

<Note>Witch Dev's vivid neon palette is one of the most visually striking in the Spooky & Magical category. If you prefer a more restrained or monochromatic look, Oracle or Sorcerer may be a better fit.</Note>
